title: THE RUN CARD BUTTONS SIT ON A SOLID STRIP
why: Seen on the 4K death card screenshot of 2026-10-08: with five lost items the run card scrolls, and the pinned Log run and return and Copy report row (v10.74) faded from clear inside itself, so half-faded feel tags showed round and behind the two buttons. The row is solid now and the fade is a strip just above it, so the tags pass under cleanly.
now: On a long run card the two buttons sit on a clean strip.
